reported_problem: Engine overheating and making strange hissing noise from the radiator area. Driver reported temp gauge spiking to red zone on highway.
diagnosis_cause: Radiator cap seal degraded, coolant leak at upper hose clamp. Thermostat stuck partially closed causing restricted flow.
work_performed: Replaced radiator cap, re-clamped upper hose, replaced thermostat assembly, pressure-tested system to 16 PSI for 15 min with no drops. Topped off coolant.
future_recommendations: Monitor coolant level weekly for 1 month. Check hose clamps at next PM service. Consider replacing upper hose if cracking visible at next inspection.
remaining_tasks: Need to order replacement upper radiator hose (not in stock). Schedule follow-up in 2 weeks.
